product_metadata.title: Prodyne Under Cabinet Paper Towel Holder, Silver and Black Small
features: Made of heavy gauge brushed stainless steel
Matte black metal and rubber accents
Paper towel roll stays in place while you tear
description: Cleverly engineered rack utilizes the natural spring quality of the brushed stainless steel to provide easy loading with no danger of the roll falling off. Stylish black rubber ball holders provide friction too help keep roll in place as you tear. Mounts under cabinet or on wall (all mounting hardware included). Spacing for paper towel is about 2 ¼".
